newsitem.title: USA: CBOT oats end sharply higher on Canadian ideas.
newsitem.headline: CBOT oats end sharply higher on Canadian ideas.

text.p: CBOT oat futures closed sharply higher with nearby March surging near the 10 cent per bushel trading limit on talk of delays in shipping Canadian oats to the U.S, traders said.
"There was talk of four to six week delays in railing oats to the U.S.," a trader said.
Transporation problems in Canada also triggered a rally in wheat futures.
Oats closed one to 9-3/4 cents per bushel higher, with March up 9-3/4 at $1.77-1/4.
